test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

It is nothing else than/ sheer foolishness that/ you have decided/ to resign.
solution:
The correct answer is- **"It is nothing else than"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"It is nothing else than"** contains error in it.
 
• The phrase **"nothing less than"** is used to emphasize how great or extreme something is.
 
 
• **For example:** The artist accept **nothing less **than perfection in his artwork.
 
 
 
• Thus, option 1) is the correct alternative.

**The Correct Sentence: ***It is **nothing less than** sheer foolishness that you have decided to resign.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the usage of some more phrases:

 
• **Bag out:** Criticize
 
• **Bear with:** be patient
 
• **Jazz up: **Make something more interesting or attractive.
 
• **Lash out:** Suddenly become violent.
